images.title: Grandmother's quilt and three laces
images.purpose: Put Grandmother's quilt and the three lace reels in front of the student before any length is said: a quilt of 15 by 10 patches and three reels of different colours, with no numbers.
images.composition: The quilt on the left, the three reels on the right, each with a plain caption.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Left, a quilt cover of exactly 15 columns by 10 rows of identical square patches, 150 patches in all, every patch 40 by 40 px with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (2 px). The patches span x 100 to 700 and y 130 to 530. Whole rows have one colour each, from the top: row 1 green, row 2 vermilion, row 3 amber, row 4 green, row 5 vermilion, row 6 amber, row 7 green, row 8 vermilion, row 9 amber, row 10 green (green is #009E73, vermilion is #D55E00, amber is #E69F00). A pink rim of reddish purple #CC79A7, 16 px wide, runs round all four sides of the patches, so its outer edge spans x 84 to 716 and y 114 to 546. Right, three lace reels stand in a row on a baseline at y 440: each reel is a flat disc of 150 px diameter with a thin dark outline (3 px) and a white hole of 40 px diameter in the middle, with a short lace tail 90 px long and 18 px high lying flat to the right of the disc at y 430 to 448. The disc centres are at (930, 365), (1110, 365) and (1290, 365); the first reel is filled vermilion #D55E00, the second green #009E73, the third teal #0072B2, and each tail has the colour of its reel. Under the quilt, centred at x 400 and y 640, the caption Grandmother's quilt; under the middle reel, centred at x 1110 and y 520, the caption Lace; both in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (40 px). No number, no length and no other text anywhere. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any number, length, unit or answer written anywhere in the frame
a quilt with a number of columns other than 15 or of rows other than 10, or reels other than 3
images.takeaway: The lace has to go all the way round the edge of the quilt, and there are three reels to choose from.
images.description: A quilt cover of 15 by 10 patches with a pink rim, and three lace reels: red, green and blue.
images.context: Concept image for the hook, Grandmother's Quilt and the Lace. It follows the idea of the picture in your maths book (a quilt of patches in rows and three lace reels) and gives no length and no answer.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student look at the quilt and the reels and wonder which reel is long enough; do not say any length. The slip to watch: choosing a reel by its colour or by how big it looks.

image_decisions.why: The quilt and the three reels put the hook question, which lace goes all the way round, in front of the student without giving the answer.
